We've got a situation I need both of your input on: the virgin polymer we have on hand isn't enough to complete the planned batch, but there is a lot of reclaimed pellets in the materials cage that hasn't been authorized for this product yet. Before I make any decision on whether to authorize that reclaimed material, I need to walk through the full picture with you both — material approval status, inspection records, storage conditions, and waste controls. Jon, can you start by giving me the quality perspective on where things stand with the reclaimed lot? And Priya, I'll need your read on environmental compliance as well.

That means we need labeled segregated storage and a hazardous-waste manifest for any discarded pellets or purge material from this lot, and the SDS must be entered in the chemical register before the run begins.

Priya, the SDS gets entered in the chemical register, and labeled segregated storage plus hazardous-waste manifest capability are set up for this lot. Can both of you commit to having those items resolved before Thursday's run? Once I have that confirmation, I'll finalize my decision on authorizing the reclaimed material at the 15% blend ratio with the 50-housing FTIR testing requirement.
